name: HyperX Cloud Stinger 2
details: 🎧 DTS Headphone:X Spatial Audio – 2-year activation included for accurate 3D audio and immersive gaming.
🛋️ Signature HyperX Comfort – Memory foam ear cushions + soft leatherette for long gaming sessions.
🔊 Superior Sound Quality – 50mm drivers with wide frequency response for clear audio and better cue detection.
🔄 Adjustable Rotating Earcups – 90° swivel design allows resting on your chest when not in use.
🎚️ Easy-Access Controls – On-headset volume adjustment for quick changes.
🎙️ Swivel-to-Mute Microphone – Flip up the mic to instantly mute and improve chat experience.
✅ Durability & Support – Backed by a 2-year warranty with free technical support.

name: Logitech G335
details: 🪶 Lightweight Design – Just 240g with adjustable suspension headband for a customized fit.
🛋️ All-Day Comfort – Soft memory foam pads + breathable sports mesh for extended gaming sessions.
🎮 Multi-Platform Plug & Play – 3.5mm jack works with PC, laptop, consoles, and mobile devices.
🎚️ Quick & Easy Controls – Smooth volume roller for fast adjustments during gameplay.
🎙️ Flip-to-Mute Microphone – Flip up to mute, down to unmute for seamless chat control.
🔊 Rich Audio Quality – 40mm drivers deliver full, immersive sound for games and music.
💬 Discord Certified – Guaranteed crystal-clear voice and audio performance.

name: Sony MDR-XB450AP
details: 🎵 Beat Response Control – Designed for tight, punchy bass performance.
🔄 Swivel Design – Compact and foldable, making travel easy and convenient.
📈 Wide Frequency Response – 5Hz–22,000Hz for clear highs and deep lows.
🎧 30mm Dome-Type Drivers – Neodymium dynamic drivers deliver precise, powerful sound.
📞 In-Line Remote & Mic – Hands-free calling and easy music control on the go.
🥁 Aluminium Fascia – Enhances bass impact and punchiness.
🔊 High Sensitivity – Loud and clear audio without distortion.
🔒 Closed-Back Design – Enfolding earcups provide noise isolation and immersive sound.

name: JBL Quantum 100
details: 🎶 40mm Large Dynamic Drivers – JBL Quantum Sound Signature delivers precise audio, from subtle footsteps to powerful explosions.
🎙️ Detachable Boom Mic – Directional mic with mute feature ensures crystal-clear voice communication.
🪶 Lightweight & Durable – Sturdy headband with memory foam cushioning for extended comfort.
🎮 Multi-Platform Compatibility – Works with PC, Xbox, PlayStation, Nintendo Switch, Mobile, Mac, and VR. Supports Windows Sonic Spatial Sound on Windows 10 PCs and Xbox One.
📏 Specifications – 120 cm cable length, built-in microphone, 96 dB sensitivity, 20Hz–20kHz frequency response, 32Ω impedance.
📦 Complete Package – Includes headset, removable mic, windshield foam, quick start guide, warranty card, and safety sheet.
✅ 1-Year Warranty – Covered by manufacturer’s warranty for reliable support.

name: Redgear Comet 7.1
details: 🎶 Immersive Sound Quality – 50mm drivers with 7.1 surround sound for a dramatically enhanced in-game audio experience.
🎙️ Noise-Cancelling Microphone – Ensures clear communication during gameplay.
🎛️ Inline Remote & Volume Control – Conveniently adjust settings with built-in controls.
🎧 Comfortable Over-Ear Design – Cushioned earcups for long gaming sessions.
🌈 RGB LED Effects – Dynamic lighting on earcups and mic tip for a stylish look.
✅ 1-Year Warranty – Covered by manufacturer warranty from the date of purchase.

name: Razer Kraken V3 X
details: 🎧 Ultra-Light Comfort – Weighs only 285g with a slim, lightweight design for all-day gaming sessions.
🔊 Razer TriForce 40mm Drivers – Patented 3-part driver design delivers richer trebles, brighter sound, and powerful bass by separating high, mid, and low frequencies.
🎮 7.1 Surround Sound – Accurate positional audio for heightened immersion and precise sound direction awareness.
🎙️ Razer HyperClear Cardioid Mic – Bendable mic with improved speech pickup and noise cancellation for crystal-clear voice communication.
🌈 Powered by Razer Chroma RGB – Customize with 16.8M colors, patterns, and dynamic in-game lighting effects; supports Chroma Studio, Visualizer, Connect, and Workshop.

name: boAt Rockerz 550
details: 🔋 Playback – Massive 500mAh battery delivers up to 20 hours of nonstop audio bliss.
🎧 50mm Dynamic Drivers – Moving coil drivers pump out immersive, powerful sound for all-day listening.
🛋️ Ergonomic Over-Ear Cushions – Plush padded earcups ensure maximum comfort and long listening sessions.
🔇 Physical Noise Isolation – Designed to block outside noise for pure, focused sound.
📡 Bluetooth v5.0 – Instant wireless connectivity with stable performance.
🔀 Dual Modes – Enjoy both wireless (Bluetooth) and wired (AUX) connections.
🛡️ Warranty – Backed by 1-year manufacturer warranty for peace of mind.

name: Corsair HS35 V2
details: 🎮 Multiplatform Gaming Headset – Designed for seamless compatibility across PC, consoles, and more.
🔊 Custom-Tuned 50mm Audio Drivers – Wide frequency range delivers powerful and precise in-game sound.
☁️ Stress-Free Comfort – Floating headband with soft fabric ear pads ensures long-hour play without strain.
🎤 High-Quality Omni-Directional Mic – Flexible design captures crystal-clear voice and commands.
🎚️ On-Ear Controls – Convenient push-in mute button and volume wheel for instant audio adjustments.

name: Cosmic Byte Equinox
details: 🎮 Long-Hour Gaming Comfort – Soft cushioned ear cups, braided cables, and a flexible auto-adjustable headband for fatigue-free sessions.
🌈 RGB Gaming Style – Flaunt true RGB colors with a customizable external display for next-level aesthetics.
🎤 Flexible Microphone – Durable mic design that bends and twists as per your preference for perfect positioning.
🖥️ Multi-Platform Compatibility – Works with PS5 and PC (dedicated software downloadable from Cosmic Byte website).
🔊 7.1 Surround Sound – Immersive audio that lets you pinpoint enemy footsteps and gain a tactical edge in every match.

name: Cosmic Byte Inferno
details: 🔀 Dual Mode Connectivity – Switch seamlessly between 2.4GHz wireless and Bluetooth for versatile device compatibility.
⚡ Ultra-Low Latency – Experience lag-free audio with just 20ms latency, ideal for gaming and real-time chats.
🔋 Extended Battery Life – Up to 40 hours of uninterrupted playback for gaming, work, or travel.
🎧 Enhanced Audio Quality – Powerful 50mm drivers deliver deep bass and crisp highs for immersive sound.
🛋️ Comfort-Focused Design – Breathable fabric cushions, adjustable headband, and ergonomic fit for long sessions.
🎤 Detachable ENC Microphone – Clear voice pickup with detachable noise-canceling mic for flexible use.
🎚️ Onboard Controls – Volume roller for quick and easy sound adjustment.
